summaries.en: OpenWhispr is a voice-to-text dictation app supporting local (Nvidia Parakeet/Whisper) and cloud (BYOK) models. It prioritizes privacy and is cross-platform, written in JavaScript. The project has 6,621 stars and 896 forks on its repository.
